action_summary: Reuse hidden typed-admission machinery so human-shaped software-engineering sentences bind the SWE capabilities already in the registry. Measured: typed selection on 5 fresh human SWE sentences went 0/5 decisive to 5/5 decisive and 5/5 relevant at 119 ms/goal; 19/19 existing selector tests and 7/7 new fresh-instance tests pass; the pre-existing front-compiler failure set is byte-identical (12 failed / 32 passed) on pristine and wired trees; three fresh execution oracles stay 2/2. A new module derives declared inputs only from stated evidence (source file -> parent dir/module, stated or discovered test file -> argv, rename grammar -> old/new names, source AST -> qualname) and removes only configuration-only template slots whose adapter AST proves a default. Effect+noun disambiguation resolves multiple bindable candidates; ambiguity still refuses. No registry, unified-model, kernel or protected-path change. An attempted primary-binder wiring was reverted because it regressed the ambiguity guard; it is recorded open in SWE_HIDDEN_WIRING_MEASUREMENT_20261027_V1.md rather than shipped. LIVE DOOR WIRING (2026-10-27): the decisive typed selection is now wired into live_brain_route_admission_v1.solve as a scoped, ambiguity-preserving retry that re-enters the SAME full gate chain (route admission, execution, tool truth, promised artifact, source change, observed effect). Measured on five fresh human SWE sentences: 1/5 -> 3/5 honest end-to-end pass, zero false passes; two remaining are honest fail-closed adapter faults (a rename module/source_root shape mismatch and a bare 'fix X' composed chain), not routing failures. New suite test_swe_typed_plan_v1.py 8/8; front-door regression suite failure set identical with and without the change (3 pre-existing fleet-drift failures from main #6292). Zero model dependency, zero incremental spend.

obs_goal.real_outcome: The editing core verifiably performs its second structural verb; the brain's refactor capability is now composable (extract then rename, rename then extract) with both verbs bound and receipted.
obs_goal.surviving_necessity: Extraction is the unique verb that shrinks functions: renaming cannot manufacture a smaller unit, and move transports whole symbols; without extract the editing core cannot reduce function size, the actual driver of reviewable diffs.

obs_inherited_system.fresh_reuse_plan: Compose extract+rename chains through registry dispatch; the NL intent layer can address extract targets by qualname because the symbol index already resolves them.
